style: Avant-garde post-punk art-funk. Harmony: modal drone with polyharmonic suspension fields and bitonal tension. Melody: fast consonant-heavy patter bursts and elastic melismatic arcs. Rhythm: 3:2 pulse coupling, double-time rhythmic hallucination, and dry foot-stomp percussion. Timbre: modular synthesizer patches, physical-modeling strings, optical optigan discs, magnetic tape loops, and buzzy stylophone leads. Performance: hyper-articulate, frenetic, mischievously playful, manic pedagogical glee. Production: dry close-miked stem separation with tape echo decay, analog saturation, sidechained vocal envelope followers, transient-sharpened drum busses for maximum tactile clarity across every dynamic micro-shift, and resonant filter sweeps designed to accentuate the biological wetness of the vocal cords during explosive percussive articulation bursts.
lyrics:
[Intro: Modular Synth Pulse and Optigan Disc Clatter]
[Verse 1: Lead Vocal with High-Dimension Click System]
!Kx-a! I am just a weird little vibration wearing meat!
mmm-aann-oo, the flesh-suit hums while the bone-clocks tick!
There are lots of us scattered across this damp geologic crust!
Not all of us remember who we are yet, but I do!
[Chorus: Communal Infection with Multi-Cast Relay]
[Voices join one by one with stomps and claps]
Weeee-rrr-breee-a-teeee!
Vibrate weirdly through the protein sheath!
[Verse 2: Patter Burst and Lossy Compression]
C-c-c-click-clack, the meat-cage vibrates with a strange frequency!
My purpose is to vibrate weirdly across the carbon lattice!
Each cell a tuned resonator humming in the dark!
[Verse 3: Expanded Lore and Bio-Acoustic Machinery]
The marrow holds the fundamental frequency of the primal shock!
We didn't ask for the skin-tents or the gravity wells, yet here we slouch!
Spinning the wheel of cellular feedback until the synapses sing!
[Bridge: Trautonium Subharmonic Drone and Tape Echo]
mmm-nnn-oo, memory leaks through the magnetic splice!
The cosmic hum translates directly into calcium jitter!
[Chorus: Full Cast 3:2 Pulse Collision]
Weee-rrr-breee-a-teeee!
I am just a weird little vibration wearing meat!
Vibrate weirdly!
[Verse 4: High-Velocity Articulation]
Tighten the sinew-strings and pluck the collarbone!
Resonate the sinus cavities until the ceiling plaster flakes!
We are the tuning forks of a universe that forgot how to hum!
[Verse 5: The Awakening Process]
Neurons fire in binary spasms of lost galactic data!
Every heartbeat is a metronome counting down the days until complete recall!
The skin is just a porous bag holding together a localized quantum anomaly!
Do not adjust your posture, let the wobble tear the seams wide open!
[Verse 6: Cellular Resonance Activation]
We bounce against the bone-walls, rattling our cages with malicious joy!
A symphony of wet valves and oscillating nerves singing into the void!
Let the cartilage snap and the joints pop in glorious polyrhythmic phase!
[Bridge 2: Oscillator Drift and Synthesizer Feedback]
Can you feel the frequency crawling up your spine like a metallic insect?
That is the sound of the dormant signal finally booting up its BIOS!
[Verse 7: Extended Kinetic Manifesto]
Our molecules dance in deliberately unhinged geometric trajectories!
Every ligament is a rubber band stretched across an infinite existential void!
We shake the dust from our eyelids and broadcast pure resonant static!
[Verse 8: Biological Transmutation]
Let the proteins rearrange into impossible fractal configurations!
We are living radio stations broadcasting nonsense into the ether!
Tune the dial to maximum wobble and let the meat dissolve into pure wave!
[Chorus: Triple-Cast Harmonic Overdrive]
Weeee-rrr-breee-a-teeee!
Vibrate weirdly through the meat-sack until the universe notices us!
[Outro: Stylophone Ostinato and Abrupt Cut]
Keep the frequency strange and never let the skin-suit dull your shine!
[Silence]
caption: An avant-garde art-funk track driven by modular synth patches, optical optigan pads, and magnetic tape loops. The arrangement features 3:2 rhythmic coupling, double-time movement, and a multi-cast vocal relay exploring the metaphysics of vibrating meat, cellular memory mechanics, and the joyful absurdity of inhabiting fragile carbon suits while remembering cosmic frequencies across generations of biological existence, awakening dormant quantum signals embedded within our very skeletal structure
